Remarks
If the boxes in the form are not sufficient to contain all relevant information, additional pages may be attached to the form. In this case, see annex must be indicated in the appropriate box.
If possible, samples or other illustrative material (pictures, designs, catalogues, etc.) of the final product and of the materials used should accompany the form.
A form shall be completed for each product covered by the request.

DLIST.ITEM.DEFINITION: third country means any country which is not referred to in Article 7 of this Protocol.

If third country materials have been worked or processed in the countries or territories referred to in Article 7 of this Protocol without obtaining origin, before being further processed in Côte d'Ivoire which is requesting the derogation, indicate the working or processing carried out in the countries or territories referred to in Article 7 of this Protocol.
The dates to be indicated are the start and end dates for the period in which EUR.1 certificates may be issued under the derogation.
Indicate either the percentage of value added in relation to the ex-works price of the product or the monetary amount of value added per unit of product.
If alternative sources of materials exist, indicate here what they are and, if possible, the reasons relating to cost or other reasons why they are not used.
Indicate possible investment or diversification of sources of supply which makes the derogation necessary for only a limited period of time.
